newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Aug production index up 7.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Aug production index up 7.6 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' manufacturing output, measured in terms of value of production index, moved up 7.6 percent to 455.3 in August versus 423 in the same month last year, the National Statistics Office reported on Thursday.
The agency also said the volume of production index, which measured the change in volume adjusted for inflation, rose by 4.4 percent in August to 154.7 compared with the year-ago level of 148.1.

In terms of value, double-digit, year-on-year increases were experienced in four sectors: electrical machinery at 22.2 percent due to the higher production of microcircuits; petroleum products, 21.9 percent; food manufacturing, 20.5 percent on account of higher output of coconut products and sugar; and the beverage sector, 10.2 percent.

Based on volume, the agency said the petroleum products sector marked the highest increase at 26.7 percent. This was followed by glass and glass products at 25.3 percent; electrical machinery, 18.0 percent; and food manufacturing, 11.9 percent.
The agency said the biggest loser, in terms of value and volume, was the wearing apparel sector which fell by 35.8 and 44.5 percent respectively on a year-on-year basis.
It said this sector continued to suffer from low demand overseas and the shutdown of some key establishments.
The agency based its data on a survey of 422 manufacturing establishments located mostly in Metro Manila. It had a response rate of 84.6 percent.
